sn7.9:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu viharati sundarikāya nadiyā tīre.
sn7.9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo sundarikāya nadiyā tīre aggiṃ juhati. aggihuttaṃ paricarati.
sn7.9:1.3: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo aggiṃ juhitvā aggihuttaṃ paricaritvā uṭṭhāyāsanā samantā catuddisā anuvilokesi:
sn7.9:1.4: ko nu kho imaṃ habyasesaṃ bhuñjeyyāti.
sn7.9:1.5: addasā kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ aññatarasmiṃ rukkhamūle sasīsaṃ pārutaṃ nisinnaṃ.
sn7.9:1.6: disvāna vāmena hatthena havyasesaṃ gahetvā dakkhiṇena hatthena kamaṇḍaluṃ gahetvā yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami.
sn7.9:1.7: atha kho bhagavā sundarikabhāradvājassa brāhmaṇassa padasaddena sīsaṃ vivari.
sn7.9:1.8: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo muṇḍo ayaṃ bhavaṃ muṇḍako ayaṃ bhavanti tatova puna nivattitukāmo ahosi.
sn7.9:2.1: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.9:9.1: [brāhmaṇo:] atha kassa cāhaṃ bho gotama imaṃ havyasesaṃ dammīti.
sn7.9:9.2: [bhagavā:] na khvāhantaṃ brāhmaṇa passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yasseso havyaseso bhutto sammā pariṇāmaṃ gaccheyya aññatra brāhmaṇa tathāgatassa vā tathāgatasāvakassa vā.
sn7.9:9.3: tena hi tvaṃ brāhmaṇa taṃ havyasesaṃ appaharite vā chaḍḍehi appāṇake vā udake opilāpehīti.
sn7.9:10.1: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo taṃ havyasesaṃ appāṇake udake opilāpesi.
sn7.9:10.2: atha kho so havyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati, ciṭiciṭāyati, sandhūpāyati, sampadhūpāyati.
sn7.9:10.3: seyyathāpi nāma phālo divase santatto udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati, ciṭiciṭāyati, sandhūpāyati, sampadhūpāyati,
sn7.9:10.4: evameva so havyaseso udake pakkhitto cicciṭāyati, ciṭiciṭāyati, sandhūpāyati, sampadhūpāyati.
sn7.9:11.1: atha kho sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo saṃviggo lomahaṭṭhajāto yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi.
sn7.9:11.2: ekamantaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho sundarikabhāradvājaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ bhagavā gāthāhi ajjhabhāsi:
sn7.9:12.3: na hi tena suddhiṃ kusalā vadanti
sn7.9:17.1: evaṃ vutte sundarikabhāradvājo brāhmaṇo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn7.9:17.3: aññataro ca panāyasmā bhāradvājo arahataṃ ahosīti.
